title: Inventory Expansion Plus
description: This mod adds more inventory tools and upgrades to those found in Inventory Expansion
body:
# Inventory Expansion Plus
An addon to [Inventory Expansion](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-expansion). Adds various new sack, bundle, and quiver types that can be crafted from modded items found in Alex's Caves, Alex's Mobs, and Farmers Delight.

Also adds a few creative-only items to be given as rewards/loot in datapacks.

## Bisack
![Bisack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3189de846ad3740d135e8a57ada98ec34332f74c_0.webp)
Sack crafted with bison fur instead of leather. Can hold two sack types instead of one.

## Dinosack
![Dinosack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7683c306cc43195ee05a5595e0cc504c5aa1e96_0.webp)
Sack crafted with Tough Hide and Archaic Vines found in the Primordial Caves. Can hold two more stacks of items than a normal sack.

## Everything Sack
Creative only item. Holds half as many stacks as a normal sack, but can hold limitless sack types.

## Spacious Sack
Creative only item. Holds twice as many stacks as a normal sack. Is fire proof like netherite.

## Double Bundle
![Double Bundle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f18e143b1462ca29f03934f5667f359f459fee8d_0.webp)
Crafted from Kangaroo Hide. Holds twice as many items as a Bundle. Can be dyed like a bundle.

## Cursed Bundle
![Cursed Bundle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95701ce82bc75a97217c64193b7fcddfba0783e5_0.webp)
Can be crafted with Shadow Silk and Dark Tatters from the Forlorn Hallows. Holds 4 stacks of items, but damages you as you take them out.

## Bundle of Joy
Creative only item. Normal bundle that stays in your inventory on death

## Triple Bundle
Creative only item. Holds three stacks of items. Is fire proof like netherite

## Pro Quiver
Crafted from Bark and Rope. Holds 12 stacks of arrows

## Premium Quiver
Creative only item. Holds 16 stacks of arrows. Is fire proof like netherite

## Bottomless Bucket
Creative only item. Sucks up liquid infinitely. When used on a flowing liquid, searches for a source and, if it finds one, sucks it up.
